parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ op: 'begin', delivery_id: String($json.body.delivery_id || ''), attempt: Number($json.body.attempt), execution_id: String($execution.id) }) }}

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ ($json.result || {}).status === 'triaged' ? { ok: true, result: ($json.result || {}) } : { ok: false, error: 'triage ' + String(($json.result || {}).status || 'returned no status') + ': ' + (Array.isArray(($json.result || {}).blockers) && ($json.result || {}).blockers.length ? ($json.result || {}).blockers.join('; ') : String(($json.result || {}).summary || 'no blockers given')).slice(0, 1500) } }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ op: 'github.labels', delivery_id: $('Begin').first().json.event.delivery_id }, { add: $('Record triage result').first().json.value.labels.add, remove: $('Record triage result').first().json.value.labels.remove })) }}

={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ op: 'github.comment', delivery_id: $('Begin').first().json.event.delivery_id }, { purpose: 'triage', body: $('Record triage result').first().json.value.comment })) }}

={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ op: 'finish', delivery_id: $('Begin').first().json.event.delivery_id }, { outcome: $('Record triage result').first().json.value.verdict === 'DUPLICATE' ? 'duplicate' : 'triaged' })) }}

={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ op: 'github.pr_upsert', delivery_id: $('Begin').first().json.event.delivery_id }, { head_sha: $('Push branch').first().json.sha, title: $('Compose implement report').first().json.pr.title, body: $('Compose implement report').first().json.pr.body })) }}

={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ op: 'github.comment', delivery_id: $('Begin').first().json.event.delivery_id }, { purpose: 'pr', body: ($json.created ? 'Opened' : 'Updated') + ' pull request ' + $json.html_url + ' for this issue. It will not be merged automatically.' + ($('Compose implement report').first().json.note ? '\n\n' + $('Compose implement report').first().json.note : '') })) }}
={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ op: 'github.comment', delivery_id: $('Begin').first().json.event.delivery_id }, { purpose: 'reply', body: $('Compose implement report').first().json.body })) }}
={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ op: 'github.comment', delivery_id: $('Begin').first().json.event.delivery_id }, { purpose: 'question', body: $('Compose implement report').first().json.body })) }}

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ ($json.result || {}).status === 'reviewed' ? { ok: true, result: ($json.result || {}) } : { ok: false, error: 'review ' + String(($json.result || {}).status || 'returned no status') + ': ' + (Array.isArray(($json.result || {}).blockers) && ($json.result || {}).blockers.length ? ($json.result || {}).blockers.join('; ') : String(($json.result || {}).summary || 'no blockers given')).slice(0, 1500) } }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ op: 'fail', delivery_id: $('Begin').first().json.event.delivery_id }, { node: ($prevNode.name.startsWith('Session done? (') ? $json.node : $prevNode.name), detail: String(($prevNode.name.startsWith('Session done? (') ? $json.node : $prevNode.name) + ': ' + ($json.error || $json.detail || ($json.state ? 'agent turn still ' + $json.state + ' when the time budget ran out' : 'unexpected result'))).slice(0, 1700) })) }}

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ ('cleanup_closed failed: ' + ($json.ok === true ? $json.errors.map(e => e.repo + '#' + e.issue_number + ': ' + e.error).join('; ') : String($json.error || 'no response'))).slice(0, 1500) }}
